name: search_flights
description: Search for available flights between two airports using live data. Use whenever the user asks about flights, prices, routes, or travel options. Convert city names to IATA airport codes before calling. Examples: Berlin to BER, Frankfurt to FRA, Munich to MUC, New York to JFK, London to LHR, Tokyo to NRT, Paris to CDG, Stuttgart to STR.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, e.g. BER

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport, e.g. JFK

trip_type.description: Whether this is a one-way or round-trip flight

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format, required only for round trips

cabin_class.description: Cabin class to search. If the user doesn't mention one, omit this field and economy will be used.

passengers.description: Number of adult passengers. If the user doesn't mention a number, omit this field and 1 will be used.

name: get_booking_options
description: Get real ways to book one specific flight the user has picked from a previous search_flights result — a seller name, price, and either a clickable booking link or a phone number. Call this only after the user has clearly picked one specific flight from results already shown, not as part of an initial search.

booking_token.description: The booking_token of the specific flight the user selected. Copy it exactly from that flight's entry in the earlier search_flights result — never guess or construct one.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport — must match the original search_flights call this flight came from

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport — must match the original search_flights call this flight came from

outbound_date.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format — must match the original search_flights call this flight came from

trip_type.description: Must match the original search_flights call this flight came from

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format, only for round trips — must match the original search_flights call this flight came from

cabin_class.description: Must match the original search_flights call this flight came from. Omit if that search didn't specify one.

passengers.description: Must match the original search_flights call this flight came from. Omit if that search didn't specify one.
